200.description:
NFL players by Sleeper id, trimmed from Sleeper's player map to what lineup decisions need: position, fantasy positions, team, status, injury_status and body part, depth chart, plus the week's bye, game, lock and flags. Before recommending a start, sit, add or drop, read flags: never start a player flagged out or bye, warn on injured, and never suggest adding, dropping, starting or benching a locked player (his game has started or finished). Ids Sleeper does not know are listed in missing_ids; if none are known the call is not_found. The full 15 MB player map is never returned.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `players` as the primary payload key.

| `fantasy_positions` | string[] |  |
| `flags` | string[] | What makes this player a bad start or an impossible drop this week. injured: any injury designation (see injury_status); out: Out, IR, PUP, Sus, NA, DNR or COV, so he will not play; bye: his team does not play this week; locked: his game has kicked off, so Sleeper will not let you move or drop him; no_team: not on an NFL team; inactive: status is not Active. |
| `game` | object | His team's game this week; null on a bye, for a free agent or when Sleeper's schedule has no game. |
| `injury_body_part` | string |  |
| `injury_start_date` | string |  |
| `injury_status` | string | Injury designation: Questionable, Doubtful, Out, IR, PUP, Sus, NA, DNR or COV; null when healthy. |
| `locked` | boolean | True when his game this week has kicked off (Sleeper status in_game or complete). A locked player cannot be dropped, benched or started. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `on_bye` | boolean | True when the checked week is his team's bye. |
| `player_id` | string | Sleeper player id; a team abbreviation for a team defense. |
| `position` | string |  |
| `practice_participation` | string |  |
| `status` | string | Roster status, e.g. Active, Inactive, Injured Reserve. |
| `team` | string | NFL team abbreviation; null for a free agent. |
| `week` | number | The week these flags were computed for. |
| `years_exp` | number |  |

type.description:
add or drop.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Players most added or dropped across all Sleeper leagues in the last lookback_hours, with counts and each player's injury, bye, lock and flags for the current week. Before recommending a start, sit, add or drop, read flags: never start a player flagged out or bye, warn on injured, and never suggest adding, dropping, starting or benching a locked player (his game has started or finished).

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `players` as the primary payload key.

The provider does not publish a field list for this tool.

These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
